summary: Enveric Biosciences filed an 8-K reporting the filing of a prospectus supplement to offer an additional $2,425,000 of common stock under an existing ATM Agreement with H.C. Wainwright. Prior sales under the ATM Agreement totaled $4,483,711. This is a routine at-the-market equity offering, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. The filing includes a legal opinion from Greenberg Traurig. There are no structural complexities, control implications, or risk-arb angle; it is a standard capital raising activity.
